notes.title: Week 11 - Practical Life
notes.content:
Montessori homeschool, Wren, week 11 (practical life shelf).
Monday: dry pouring with the two little ceramic pitchers — steady hands, almost no spills by the third try.
Tuesday-Wednesday: spooning lentils between bowls; she slowed herself down without being asked.
Thursday: buttoning frame, needed help with the top button only.
Friday: table scrubbing, full sequence unprompted.
Observation: she keeps drifting to the counting beads shelf mid-cycle — ready for numbers.
Next week: move to botany and counting; art shelf still missing an easel and child scissors.
